name: PhariaAI
desc: Sovereign, explainable generative AI stack for regulated organisations
desc_zh: 面向受监管机构的主权型、可解释生成式 AI 技术栈
solves: Regulated industries can neither send data out of the country nor return an answer with no stated basis. This runs entirely on your own machine.
solves_zh: 受管行业既不能把数据送出境外，也交不出一个说不清依据的答案。这套东西整套跑在你自己机器上。
best_for: You work on finance, government, or other projects with compliance and explainability requirements.
best_for_zh: 你在做金融、政务这类有合规和可解释要求的项目。
